# Community & People

> Life at MENASCO beyond the job site: our blood drive, healthcare partnership, Culture Day celebrations, Dubai Run, career fairs and the Training & Mentoring Centre developing our people.

## Blood Drive

Giving back, one donation at a time. Our team rolled up their sleeves to support the community's blood supply.

## Investing in Healthcare

A partnership for our people's wellbeing. MENASCO and Aster healthcare partnership for Medcare Royal Hills Hospital.

## Culture Day

Many cultures, one team. Celebrating the nationalities and traditions that make up MENASCO.

## Dubai Run

Running together through the heart of the city. Our team joined the city's runners on Sheikh Zayed Road for Dubai Run.

## Career Fairs

Meeting the engineers of tomorrow. Connecting with students and young professionals at career fairs.

## Training & Mentoring Centre

Building the next generation of engineers. Hands-on training and mentoring that turn skills into certified expertise.
